params.name: limit
params.description: Number of results to return per page.

params.name: mode
params.description: Level of detail in the response.

params.name: offset
params.description: The initial index from which to return the results.

params.name: ordering
params.description: Which field to use when ordering the results.

items.docs:
#### Modes
Levels of detail in the response - `normal`, `detailed`

Example - [/mission_patches/?mode=detailed](./?mode=detailed)

#### Filters
Parameters - `agency__id`, `agency__name`, `agency__name__contains`, `id`, `ids`, `name`, `name__contains`

Example - [/mission_patches/?agency__id=147](./?agency__id=147)

#### Search
Fields searched - `agency__name`, `name`

Example - [/mission_patches/?search=Ariane](./?search=Ariane)

#### Ordering
Fields - `agency__name`, `id`, `name`, `priority`
